      "source": [
        "clean_df = df.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fill missing Age values using the median\n",
        "clean_df[\"Age\"] = clean_df[\"Age\"].fillna(clean_df[\"Age\"].median())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fill missing Embarked values using the most frequent value\n",
        "clean_df[\"Embarked\"] = clean_df[\"Embarked\"].fillna(clean_df[\"Embarked\"].mode()[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Drop Cabin because too much data is missing\n",
        "clean_df = clean_df.drop(columns=[\"Cabin\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Missing values handled successfully!\")"
      ],
      "execution_count": 14,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",

          ]
